# Screenista

> Digital out-of-home platform. Advertisers book connected screens by the second. Screen owners monetize idle airtime.

Screenista Private Limited. Public site: https://screenista.ai

## Products

- Advertiser app: https://app.screenista.ai
- Partner site: https://partner.screenista.ai
